title: bessbid: a bidding algorithm for a 100 MW / 100 MWh battery in EMA's BESS Bidding Algorithm Hackathon
description: Python code that generates a one-month bid schedule for a hypothetical 100 MW / 100 MWh battery across Energy, Primary Reserve, Contingency Reserve and Regulation, for the Energy Market Authority of Singapore's BESS Bidding Algorithm Hackathon (Phase 1). It includes a reconstruction of the competition's market clearing, structural price forecasts, a state-of-charge-safe bid planner, a template writer and validator, and a backtester. The competition datasets are confidential and are not included.
